fact.claim: AWS Private CA can sign ACM certificates across accounts: the signing CA and the ACM certificate reside in different AWS accounts, and access to the CA has been granted to the account where the certificate resides.
fact.question: Can an ACM certificate in one account be signed by an AWS Private CA in another account?

values.display: access to the CA has been granted
